text:
Glad it's useful. When you're ready for the next step, I can help with any of these:

- **Draft a section.** Statement of Need or Program Design are the best places to start, since they carry 60% of the score.
- **Build the logic model.** I can turn your activities and outcomes into a one-page table.
- **Write SMART objectives** from your program details.
- **Draft the budget narrative** from your line items, including cost per participant.
- **Review drafts against the rubric.** Paste any section and I'll flag gaps a reviewer would mark down.

Just share whatever program details or drafts you have.
